purpose: Start the real MeshCore HTTP server under recorder-managed lifecycle control.
Show registration, lease rotation, discovery state changes, and the compared validation boundaries with actual responses.
output:
MeshCore registration, lease, discovery, and validation demonstration

=== first registration ===
REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.2:9000", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.2:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:56:03+08:00", "instance": "node-b", "leaseToken": "9c1964f3151e9a8bf6a24f7b8708cec4021e4d305c5393c1b14630c8ee06af83", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}, "status": 201}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 201 with a non-empty leaseToken and RFC3339 expiresAt

=== second instance ===
REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-a
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:56:03+08:00", "instance": "node-a", "leaseToken": "c8ffe4dadfd80a156735370860b0651b1bf4b8fb3fc22f9769ebd53232c254c8", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}, "status": 201}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 201

=== sorted discovery ===
REQUEST GET /v1/discovery/demo-svc
ACTUAL {"body": {"instances": [{"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:56:03.40494266+08:00", "instance": "node-a", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}, {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.2:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:56:03.400412503+08:00", "instance": "node-b", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}]}, "status": 200}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 200; node-a then node-b; no leaseToken in instances

=== overwrite rotates lease ===
REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.9:9000", "metadata": {"build": "new"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v3", "weight": 75, "zone": "z2"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.9:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:56:03+08:00", "instance": "node-b", "leaseToken": "4bf3f65f515985d1dcc6e63b611836c862edcdcf38687ca8ccaaabfaa69983b2", "metadata": {"build": "new"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v3", "weight": 75, "zone": "z2"}, "status": 200}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 200 with a new leaseToken

=== old token cannot renew ===
REQUEST POST /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b/heartbeat
ACTUAL {"body": {"error": {"code": "lease_conflict"}}, "status": 409}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 409 lease_conflict

=== current token renews ===
REQUEST POST /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b/heartbeat
ACTUAL {"body": "", "status": 204}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 204

=== current token unregisters ===
REQUEST DELETE /v1/services/demo-svc/instances/node-b
ACTUAL {"body": "", "status": 204}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 204

=== deleted instance stays absent ===
REQUEST GET /v1/discovery/demo-svc
ACTUAL {"body": {"instances": [{"endpoint": "http://10.0.0.1:9000", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:56:03.40494266+08:00", "instance": "node-a", "metadata": {"team": "core"}, "ttlSeconds": 30, "version": "v2", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}]}, "status": 200}
PUBLIC EXPECTATION 200 containing only node-a

### Boundary reproduction shared by both sealed candidates

REQUEST PUT /v1/services/demo-boundary/instances/meta
INPUT {"endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:9001", "metadata": {"key": ""}, "ttlSeconds": 20, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}
ACTUAL {"body": {"endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:9001", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:55:53+08:00", "instance": "meta", "leaseToken": "f196e9c4806d263dbc6cae8cdbe55c2298953231e53953695b35767fc5173dec", "metadata": {"key": ""}, "ttlSeconds": 20, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}, "status": 201}

ACTUAL {"body": {"instances": [{"endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:9001", "expiresAt": "2026-10-03T02:55:53.440361364+08:00", "instance": "meta", "metadata": {"key": ""}, "ttlSeconds": 20, "version": "v1", "weight": 10, "zone": "z1"}]}, "status": 200}

REQUEST GET /v1/services/bad!/instances/node
ACTUAL {"body": {"error": {"code": "validation_error"}}, "status": 400}
